result.reasoning: This commit migrated RuleSet's getParents() method from using ConceptRegistry.getConceptDescriptor().getParentsNames() (which returned only direct parents) to SConceptOperations.getAllSuperConcepts(nextConcept, false) — incorrectly using the "all ancestors" variant instead of the direct-parents equivalent. This caused the rule-matching traversal (getParents is used for BFS-style traversal per level) to behave incorrectly, producing the typesystem error described in the fix. The fix simply corrects this by replacing getAllSuperConcepts with getDirectSuperConcepts, restoring the original (pre-migration) direct-parent semantics.
